title: Conductor Kernel Stream State
description: Base schema for stream-mode (continuous, event-driven) kernel state. Stream state is stored long-horizon in Qdrant keyed by stream_id per REQ-KER-012, and a thin pointer file may sit in the working directory. Domain plugins extend via domain_extensions per REQ-KER-003.

schema_version.description: Kernel publishes stream-state schema at 3.0 alongside workflow-state.schema.json.

domain.description: Domain plugin identifier (e.g., 'soc', 'dev'). Selects schema extension and policy bindings.

stream_id.description: Stream identifier. Equal to the n8n workflow_id per REQ-KER-010. Stable across kernel restarts.

stream_name.description: Human-readable stream name for logs and dashboards.

n8n_workflow_id.description: Explicit n8n workflow id. Redundant with stream_id but recorded for clarity in cross-system traces.

n8n_url.description: Base URL of the n8n instance hosting this stream. Default http://localhost:5679.

parent_stream_id.description: If this stream was spawned from another stream via kernel.stream.spawn_workflow, the parent stream's id. Null for root streams.

subscriptions.description: Event sources this stream is subscribed to. Used by kernel.stream.init to wire up n8n triggers.

schedule.description: Cron expression or polling interval (for kind=cron or kind=polling).

event_schema_ref.description: Path or URI to the JSON Schema for events from this source. Used by REQ-XCT-007 boundary validation.

filter.description: Per-source filter expression (e.g., severity >= high). Free-form.

authentication.description: Required per RC-4 / F-10. kernel.stream.handle_event MUST verify authentication BEFORE schema validation. Auth failure → audit event stream.event_auth_failure, drop to DLQ, no agent dispatch. Webhook URL secrecy is NOT considered authentication.

kind.description: Authentication mechanism. 'none' is permitted only when stream.init emits an explicit warning audit event (stream.init.auth_none_warning) recording operator-acknowledged risk.

secret_ref.description: URI to the secret material (e.g., 'vault://path/to/secret', 'env://SECRET_NAME', 'file:///etc/secrets/...'). NEVER inline. Required when kind != 'none'.

verification_field.description: Where on the inbound request the verification material is located, e.g., 'header.X-Signature', 'body.signature', 'header.Authorization'. Required when kind != 'none'.

algorithm.description: Cryptographic algorithm where applicable (e.g., 'hmac-sha256', 'rs256' for oauth_jwt). Implementation default is 'hmac-sha256' for kind='hmac'.

audit_warning_acknowledged.description: When kind='none', operator must set true to acknowledge the audit warning. Otherwise stream.init returns KER-SI-005 stream_auth_none_unacknowledged.

last_event_id.description: Most recent event id handled. Used for resume semantics and deduplication.

running_counters.description: Counters that increment over the life of the stream.

health_metrics.description: Health metrics returned by kernel.stream.health per REQ-KER-013. Sourced from n8n_list_executions + audit emissions. Populated on read, not stored persistently — schema declared so consumers know the shape.

spawned_workflow_ids.description: Workflow-mode tasks spawned by this stream via kernel.stream.spawn_workflow per REQ-KER-014. Each entry is a state-file path or a workflow id depending on domain.

pause_state.description: Pause/resume state per REQ-KER-012. Stream pauses via kernel.stream.pause; resumes via kernel.stream.resume.

paused_by.description: Identifier of who/what paused — operator id, agent name, or system.

resume_at.description: Scheduled resume time, or null for indefinite pause.

consumed_offsets.description: Per-source offset cursors for resumable consumption. Free-form because offset shape is source-specific (n8n execution id, Qdrant point id, log index, etc.).

configuration.description: Static configuration for this stream — backoff policy, batch size, concurrency, retention. Free-form because policy is per-domain.

audit_session_id.description: Long-lived audit session id used by kernel.audit_emit for all events from this stream.

domain_extensions.description: Extension point per REQ-KER-003. Domain plugins write arbitrary structure here. Kernel never reads or writes these fields. Example for CLUE alert-router stream: {alert_dedup_window_s, alert_severity_floor, mitre_coverage_targets, edr_provider}.
